Do you want something quick? Do you have a specific type of food? I have a really easy stir fry recipe that I make when I'm busy.

1 bowl of large deveigned shrimp

3 packets of udan noodles (about 2 cups worth of noodles)

1/2 onion finely chopped

1/2 tablespoon of finely chopped garlic

1/2 tablespoon of finely chopped ginger

3 tablespoons of red wine vinegar

1/4 cup of soy sauce or more (add to flavor)

2 tablespoons of olive oil

1 tablespoon of sesame oil

two hand-fulls of broccoli salad

Start with 2 tablespoons of cooking olive oil add to wok, once oil is warm add onion, garlic, and ginger let cook for 2-3 minutes, add sesame oil, then add shrimp and broccoli salad, stir for 3-5 minutes, add noodles. Stir for an addition 2-3 minutes, add red wine vinegar and soy to taste. Stir an additional 2-3 minutes.
